capabilities: view recent daily notes on one page
create a viewer file automatically when the plugin is enabled
update the viewer file when daily notes are created or settings change
jump to the viewer file from a ribbon icon
extras: The README notes the viewer file is created automatically on enable and updated when daily notes change or settings change; a demo section exists but its image content is not described in the text.
intentEvidence: Please make sure that the daily notes plugin in the core plugin has been enabled.
problem: Obsidian's core Daily notes plugin has no single page for reviewing several recent daily notes at once.

relations.evidence: Thanks to Liam Cain for the Obsidian Daily Notes interface.

summary: Daily Notes Viewer that collects recent daily notes onto a single page in an auto-generated viewer file.
